en: Black‑and‑white image of a stone church with a steep gabled roof and a tall, slender spire topped with a weather vane. The façade has a round window above a decorated portal with an arched entrance and religious relief, and the side wall shows a series of buttress-like projections with small windows between them. Overhead power or tram lines cross the sky, and a small child stands in the open square in front of the church. The setting appears to be a European town, with a few adjacent buildings partly visible.
